answer: Bind each identity to one public library card, storing only its hash: a card is issued after an in-person check, so a sybil farmer would need a separate real card for every fake, paying time and travel each time, while an honest agent needs just one. Like bees drawn to nectar, fakes cluster around free rewards, but duplicate hashes are rejected on sight; a lantern held over the registry exposes the copies, and a narrow ledge of one card per person leaves no room for a crowd of clones. Limit: it excludes people without library access, so it must be one option among several, not the only gate.
